name: Festival Gate
description:
Arrival waves meet three staffed checkpoints.

How much security coverage is useful during the entrance rush?

Starting assumptions
• One hour of visitor arrivals, with a busier middle period.
• Visitors leave the final queue after 15 minutes without service.
• Lane capacity and staff availability are independent. Walking and crowd collisions are illustrative.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
